scope: Read-only native-score post-service reservation audit; stride67,74 sampled complete plans per seed, exact full reference trajectories. These are observed heuristic candidate conflicts, not removable reservations or throughput bounds.
interpretation: Post-service-only conflicts exist for owners with known next errands and finishing owners. Samples classify the easiest qualifying physical-heuristic candidate; they do not measure the outcome of a joint continuation policy. Counts are robot observations, not unique robots; gains overlap.
